guidance.statement: Q4 smartphone volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million units.
guidance.quote: Q4 volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million.

guidance.statement: Mobile phone business margin is expected to be between 2.8% to 3.2%.
guidance.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.

guidance.statement: Target to expand smartphone camera modules from 40 million units to 190-200 million units per annum.
guidance.quote: target to expand volumes of smartphone camera modules from 40 million units in this fiscal to 190 million to 200 million units per annum.

guidance.statement: Expects export revenues to close at almost INR5,500 crores to INR6,000 crores in current fiscal.
guidance.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost INR5,500 crores, INR6,000 crores in the current fiscal.

guidance.statement: Display module capacity in first phase will be 24 million per annum for smartphones.
guidance.quote: In the first phase, we are creating a capacity of 24 million per annum for smartphones

guidance.statement: Mass production for front-loading washing machines to start by Q2 FY27 with 300,000 units capacity.
guidance.quote: mass production to start by Q2 financial year '26-'27 with annual capacity of 300,000 units.

guidance.statement: Conservative basis mobile business volume expected around 60 million to 65 million units for components play.
guidance.quote: we should be even a conservative basis, somewhere around 60 million, 65 million units.

guidance.statement: Display business capex is estimated closer to INR1,100 crores to INR1,200 crores.
guidance.quote: We will be putting capex of closer to INR1,100 crores, INR1,200-odd crores.

achieved.claim: Working capital cycle remains at negative 7 days with a net debt of INR246 crores.
Smartphone volumes for Q3 reached around 6.9 million units.
Q Tech camera module revenue for Q3 was closer to INR400 crores.
Achieved 9-month export revenues of almost INR4,000 crores to INR4,500 crores.

pushback.concern: What is leading to this delay in the Vivo JV and is it procedural?
How will mobile margins shape up with PLI benefits potentially going away?

output.tone_why: Management expresses strong confidence in component integration, backward integration, and long-term growth despite near-term headwinds.
